gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a); AC-8
cases.note: The first draw after launch has no last (KR-Q1): pool of 4, u 0 → REX. The queue is never quiet here, so no change.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a); AC-8
cases.note: Q is not in the word: no light, counts toward nothing.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R5 (KR-Q6); AC-7
cases.note: A row tap lights that key only; a hardware or hint G lights both. E and G make EGG Due.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a) (KR-Q3, Q4, Q5); AC-9, AC-10
cases.note: Not while the queue holds a key, nor while a pointer is on a key (current position); the change draws at its start (last = REX: 15 candidates, u 0.125 → the 2nd, NEST). At +0.2 a tap hits the old E (it counts only for REX), at +0.4 the new N.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2 (with TASK-089a) (KR-Q1: last kept across a Title entry); AC-12
cases.note: u 0.1875 with no last → 3 (ROAR); then last 3: u 0 → 0 (REX); then last 0: 15 candidates, u 0.1875 → the 3rd, ROAR.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R7; R2 (KR-Q4, Q9; TASK-089a); AC-14
cases.note: The same word and pressed letters after a short background; a Due word does not change during its fade-in, only once Showing (first frame at or after 0.3 s).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R8 (KR-Q2, Q10); AC-15
cases.note: On: drawn at panel close (no last yet: u 0.125 → NEST). Off: the hit rects go at once (a tap there is not a row press) and the pressed set is dropped; NEST is kept only as last (u 0 → REX).

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2c, R7 (play clock); AC-13
cases.note: Frozen at play 0.2: the light (tau 0.1) and the row fade-in (0.2 of 0.3) hold; after resume they continue.

cases.source: gdd: onscreen-keyboard-row.md R2a (KR-Q11); AC-16
cases.note: No rowWords: T-Rex is skipped (a hyphen), Fossil → FOSSIL; a pool of one never draws and never changes.
